Multiplastics (Europe) Limited are a UK-based converter, distributor and stockist of flexible packaging films, supplying manufacturers, printers and packaging companies throughout the UK and Europe.  Part of a family-owned global manufacturer, we specialise in the conversion and distribution of Polypropylene (BOPP), Polyester (PET), Polystyrene (OPS), Thermoforming, High-Barrier Laminates, Heat-Sealable Papers and Printed Films and Materials. ​ Our extensive range of materials serves a wide variety of markets, including bakery, confectionery, food, pet-food, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, envelope and label manufacturers. We also supply specialist films for printing and laminating, with solutions available to meet a broad range of packaging and processing equipment and requirements.

Our Comprehensive Product Range ​ Our extensive portfolio of flexible packaging materials is tailored to your every need and includes: ​​ Polyester, Polypropylene, and Polystyrene Films: Known for their durability and clarity, these films are ideal for applications that require robust packaging, such as envelope, carton, food and pharmaceutical products. ​ Printed, Laminated & High Barrier Film: Designed to protect and extend the shelf life of your products, these films provide advanced barrier properties and are customisable to display your branding. ​ Plastic-Free & Environmental Materials: From recyclable and biodegradable materials to compostable laminates, we offer a growing range of materials designed to support more sustainable packaging choices. Our range also includes plastic-free solutions and films containing recycled content, including options that can help meet the requirements for exemption from the UK Plastic Packaging Tax. ​ Perforated & L-Seal Films: Engineered to offer optimal breathability and efficient sealing, our perforated and L-seal films are perfect for products that require ventilation, such as fresh produce and bakery goods. ​ Pouches, Sheets & Bags: Our stand-up pouches, sheets and wicketed bags provide reliable packaging options for bakery, lidding, vacuum forming, and beyond. With a variety of sizes and materials, they are trusted across multiple sectors. Whether you’re seeking specialised films for bakery goods, healthcare, or industrial applications, our products deliver performance and protection trusted across the UK, Europe, and beyond. ​ Contact Us Today ​​​ Need help finding the right solution for your application?
